name: Aaron Smith Industries
old_description: We only use high quality material,and top of the line equipment.
about:
Aaron Smith Industries is a family-owned fabrication shop based in Eagle Creek, Oregon, just outside Portland. The company operates from a facility on SE Highway 224 and emphasizes high-quality materials and top-tier equipment.

The shop provides custom fabrication across metal, wood, plastic, and foam. Core processes include certified TIG, MIG, and ARC welding with mobile service; cutting via CNC router, laser, plasma, sawing, and light-gauge metal shearing; sheet metal and pipe forming; sand blasting; and finishes such as powder coating, painting, and wood staining. Design work is handled in-house using V-Carve, Laserworks V8, SketchUp, and Adobe software. The equipment roster features a Smart Shop CNC router, CNC router table, laser cutter/engraver, plasma cutter, saws, and a light-gauge shear.

Aaron Smith Industries serves customers needing signage, custom woodworking, metal fabrication, rapid prototyping, artistic sculpture, jewelry, awards, memorials, and theme-park elements. Past projects cited by the company include 3D model making, sign making, wood carving, CNC routing, engraving, milling, new product designs, custom fireplaces, door panels, statues, jewelry, stone cutting, 3D sculptures, earrings, gifts, personalized awards, memorials, and commemorative plaques.

The company states its differentiation lies in quality, honesty, and speed—"Today it is rare to find quality, honesty and speed. Especially all in the same business," reads one testimonial. Aaron Smith Industries says it uses only high-quality materials and top-of-the-line equipment, maintains precise layout and attention to detail, and aims for efficient turnaround without sacrificing quality, backed by a commitment to 100% customer satisfaction.
